turns.question: What share of our orders on 1 and 2 October 2026 was cancelled?
turns.answer: About 16.7% of the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026 were cancelled (cancellation rate, a share, 1 to 2 October 2026). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: How did you calculate that rate?
turns.answer: The metric is defined as "Share of orders cancelled." In plain words, the query counted the orders with status cancelled placed on 1 and 2 October 2026, divided by all orders placed on those two days (cancelled included), and returned that share. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
